The SELF-CONTAINED-GENERATION certificate is overturned on executed evidence. H-B as first built was fairly tested and lost at ITER-56/57; that is on the record and was missing from the previous pass. This is not a resurrection claim: everything on the record leans against Layer-2 value and the author's own catalog-tier downgrade of the Layer-1 findings stands.
